evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese Character Database), CUHK
evidence.field: 甲骨部件分析 / 用 / form, proposed original sense, and borrowing
evidence.text: The entry interprets the oracle-bone graph as a bucket with its body on the left and handle on the right, citing 合集19762 and 21405. It attributes the analysis to 于省吾、楊樹達、裘錫圭 and says the graph was borrowed for ‘put into effect; use.’ This is the database’s paleographic interpretation, not an independently inspected artifact reading in this research.
evidence.title: 漢字甲骨部件分析

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese Character Database), CUHK

evidence.text: The entry says 合集1616 and 花東459 use 用/不用 after divination statements to indicate whether the proposed action was carried out. This supports an early graph use meaning ‘carry out/use’; it does not establish when that use began relative to a bucket noun sense.
evidence.title: 漢字甲骨部件分析

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese Character Database), CUHK
evidence.field: 甲骨部件分析 / 用 / bronze and Qin-slip examples
evidence.text: For bronze inscriptions the entry records 用 as a verb ‘use’, a preposition equivalent to 以, and a conjunction expressing sequence or cause, citing 召仲鬲, 虢季子白盤, 守宮盤, and 禹鼎. It also cites a Warring States Qin-slip example, 睡虎地秦簡《秦律十八種》簡100, where 用 is read 桶 in a container/measure context. The entry supplies no absolute dates for each cited inscription or a complete semantic chronology.
evidence.title: 漢字甲骨部件分析

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese Character Database), CUHK
evidence.field: 甲骨部件分析 / 用 / relationship to 同
evidence.text: This entry says 用 and 同 are one graph differentiated into two forms; it does not analyze 同 as a phonetic component inside 用. Its account differs from the dossier’s Wiktionary description of a compound with a handle added to 同. A separate 同 entry describes its own oracle forms and readings, but does not establish a phonetic-component role for 同 in 用.
evidence.title: 漢字甲骨部件分析

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese Character Database), CUHK
evidence.field: 同 entry / modern pronunciation and graphic analysis
evidence.text: The inspected 同 entry gives Mandarin readings tong and describes its oracle graph as a central circular form with 口, citing competing analyses by 裘錫圭 and 王子揚. These are 同 readings, not 用 readings, and the entry does not establish 同 as an internal phonetic component in 用. No component sound array is justified by the evidence inspected.

search_audit.query: 用 甲骨文 桶 形声 同 古文字 字源
search_audit.outcome: Opened and inspected the CUHK 用 page and Academia Sinica form-evolution page. Commons search result exposed its description but exact page open failed.

search_audit.query: 用 同 字源 分化 桶 甬 古文字 于省吾
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the 用 entry and its linked 同 entry. CUHK describes a graphic differentiation relationship; the separate 同 entry does not establish 同 as a phonetic component in 用.
Official Unicode lookup was attempted but inaccessible. A third-party Unihan mirror was inspected and reports yòng; not used as a substitute for the required official click-through.

gaps: The bucket interpretation remains an attributed paleographic analysis; no oracle-bone facsimile was independently opened or visually assessed.

The exact first occurrence and absolute dating of the bucket/container sense and the ‘put into effect/use’ sense remain unsettled. Oracle-bone examples support the latter use, while Qin-slip evidence preserves 用 read 桶 in a measure context; this does not establish chronology by itself.

The proposed whole-graph borrowing account cannot be tested phonetically: no recoverable spoken name or pronunciation for the pictured bucket/object was established. Mandarin or reconstructed pronunciation of 用 does not establish the depicted object's name.

The dossier’s separate analysis of 用 as 同 plus a handle, with 同 acting phonetically, conflicts with the inspected CUHK account. No suitable component sound comparison was established, so no component sound array is provided.

The received 說文 analysis 從卜從中 is present in the dossier, while the inspected CUHK entry quotes 說文’s gloss and reports a later graphic-differentiation account involving 同. The inspected pages do not adjudicate the textual/paleographic disagreement.
Modern 用 kMandarin yòng is available in the supplied local row, but the official Unicode page was inaccessible; the third-party mirror is not the required official verification.

The Commons file description surfaced in search results, but the exact description page could not be opened, and its rights statement points to a separate permission agreement. Xiaoxuetang’s inspected rights notice does not grant CC0 reuse. No glyph image is selected because a verified usable image URL and reuse provenance were not obtained.
The CUHK character entry was used as a concise paraphrased, character-specific citation; no corpus-wide extract or bulk reuse terms were verified. No local extract is recommended.

limitations.text: No image candidate met the verification requirement in this run. Commons search surfaced a modern digital Shuowen seal-script drawing of 用, but opening its exact description page failed, so the original image link and applicable permission terms could not be checked. Xiaoxuetang’s character form catalogue was inspected, but its rights notice limits ordinary use and does not provide the stipulated CC0 image permission.
